# Vital Design

> React 18 component library with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4.
> New work lives in `src-v2/` and is installed from the shadcn-compatible registry.

Important notes:

- Install components with `npx shadcn@latest add @vital-design/<name>`.
  Registry: `https://vittal.design/r/{name}.json`
- `@fed/vital-design` on npm is the legacy `src/` surface. Do not use it for new components.
- Import icons from exact paths (`@/icons/SearchIcon`), not a barrel.
- `Button` / `SplitButton` take icons as children with `data-icon="inline-start"` or `data-icon="inline-end"`. There is no `icon` prop.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](/docs/getting-started): Vital Design is a React 18 component library built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4.
- [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation): Install Vital Design in your React project.
- [Tailwind CSS Setup](/docs/getting-started/tailwind-setup): Configure Tailwind CSS 4 to work with Vital Design components and design tokens.
- [Your First Component](/docs/getting-started/first-component): Add your first Vital Design component to a React app.

## Components

- [Alert](/docs/components/alert): A composable message surface for confirmations, warnings, and contextual notices.
- [Autocomplete](/docs/components/autocomplete): Free-form text input with filtered suggestions and optional inline completion.
- [Avatar](/docs/components/avatar): Display a user's profile picture with fallback to initials or a default icon, available in 12 color variants.
- [Badge](/docs/components/badge): Small status indicator pill with semantic color variants and number or text content.
- [Button](/docs/components/button): Trigger actions with default, text, and ghost variants, multiple themes, and icon support.
- [ButtonGroup](/docs/components/button-group): A composable layout primitive for grouped button controls.
- [Calendar](/docs/components/calendar): Date picker calendar built on react-day-picker. Single, range, and multi-select modes with full classNames and components overrides.
- [Card](/docs/components/card): Composable card surface with header, title, description, action, content, and footer slots.
- [Checkbox](/docs/components/checkbox): A checkbox input supporting checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states. Built on Base UI for accessibility.
- [Chip](/docs/components/chip): A toggleable pill component for filters, tags, and multi-select options.
- [Collapsible](/docs/components/collapsible): An interactive panel that expands and collapses to reveal additional content.
- [Combobox](/docs/components/combobox): An input picker for searching and selecting one or many options.
- [Command](/docs/components/command): A composable command palette primitive built on cmdk, with input, list, items, groups, and shortcut display.
- [Dialog](/docs/components/dialog): A modal surface for focused confirmations, decisions, and short forms.
- [DropdownMenu](/docs/components/dropdown-menu): An action menu where each item fires a callback. Use this when items invoke actions rather than bind to a form value.
- [Editable](/docs/components/editable): Inline editable text field with display, input, and textarea parts.
- [Field](/docs/components/field): Composable form field layout with labels, descriptions, errors, and groups.
- [Icons](/docs/components/icons): Built-in SVG icon set used across Vital Design components.
- [Input](/docs/components/input): Text input components including Input, PasswordInput, and Textarea.
- [Item](/docs/components/item): Content rows with media, title, description, and actions.
- [Label](/docs/components/label): Accessible label text associated with a form control.
- [NumberInput](/docs/components/number-input): A numeric input with stepper buttons, locale-aware formatting, and clamped step interactions.
- [Popover](/docs/components/popover): A floating panel anchored to a trigger element, used for tooltips with rich content, profile cards, and contextual overlays.
- [Progress](/docs/components/progress): Progress primitives and segmented status indicators.
- [RadioGroup](/docs/components/radio-group): A single-selection group of radio buttons.
- [Resizable](/docs/components/resizable): Accessible resizable panels backed by react-resizable-panels.
- [Scroll Area](/docs/components/scroll-area): Scrollable viewport with optional edge fade.
- [SearchBar](/docs/components/search-bar): A search input with an icon. Supports instant onChange and explicit onSearch (Enter / icon click).
- [Select](/docs/components/select): A dropdown for choosing one or many options from a flat list.
- [Separator](/docs/components/separator): Horizontal or vertical divider.
- [Sheet](/docs/components/sheet): A side-anchored dialog that slides in from any edge — for navigation, filters, forms, and inspectors.
- [Sidebar](/docs/components/sidebar): Application sidebar with structure, behavior, and a basic neutral default skin. Product-specific looks live on blocks.
- [Skeleton](/docs/components/skeleton): Placeholder blocks for content that is still loading.
- [Slider](/docs/components/slider): Select a numeric value or range from a bounded scale.
- [Spinner](/docs/components/spinner): Loading indicator for pending actions and async content.
- [SplitButton](/docs/components/split-button): A split action built from ButtonGroup with a primary action and a separate toggle trigger.
- [Switch](/docs/components/switch): A toggle control for boolean on/off settings.
- [Table](/docs/components/table): Semantic <table> primitives with VD tokens for static tables and custom compositions.
- [Tabs](/docs/components/tabs): Switch between related panels with underline or pill tab styles.
- [Tag](/docs/components/tag): A label component for categorization, status, and filtering. Supports 12 colors, two variants, and optional remove action.
- [Textarea](/docs/components/textarea): Multi-line text input with consistent border, focus, and disabled states.
- [Time Picker](/docs/components/time-picker): Three-column time picker (hours, minutes, seconds) with click-to-select and CSS scroll-snap.
- [Toast](/docs/components/toast): Status-coloured notifications dispatched imperatively from anywhere in the app.
- [Toolbar](/docs/components/toolbar): Flex layout primitive with role="toolbar". Lays out actions, separators, and spacers above tables, editors, or panels.
- [Tooltip](/docs/components/tooltip): A short, transient hint anchored to a trigger element with arrow and side controls.

## Blocks

- [Sidebar / Cloud / Flat](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/flat): Base cloud sidebar. Frosted glass skin, flat nav with no submenus, no account footer.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Inline Submenus](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/inline-submenus): A sidebar with submenus. Cloud product sidebar panel with frosted glass, inline nested nav, primary text states, active edge rail, and a bullet collapse control.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Collapsible Submenus](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/collapsible-submenus): A sidebar with collapsible inline submenus. Same Cloud frost skin and account footer as Inline Submenus; nested items fold with Collapsible.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Dropdown Submenus](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/dropdown-submenus): A cloud sidebar that shows submenus as a dropdown-menu. Header Add action, frosted glass skin, no account footer.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Secondary Nav](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/secondary-nav): Cloud sidebar with secondary navigation and account footer. Frosted glass skin, flat main nav.
- [Sidebar / Cloud / Header Actions](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/header-actions): Cloud sidebar with a mark-only logo, header search and notifications, and account footer.
- [Data Table — Candidate Tree](/docs/blocks/data-table-group-01): Tree-style data table with grouped candidate rows, action bar, filter dropdown, and column pinning.
- [Data Table — ESG Emission Tree](/docs/blocks/data-table-group-02): Expandable tree data table with sticky pinned rail, sortable headers, inline switch toggles, and an action bar.
- [Data Table — Editable Cells](/docs/blocks/data-table-group-04): Editable data table with inline text cells, popover pickers, tag multi-select, and date selection.

## Design Tokens

- [Colors](/docs/design-tokens/colors): Vital Design color system — primitive palettes, semantic aliases, and named component tokens.
- [Typography](/docs/design-tokens/typography): Font family, type scale, weights, and text style conventions used across Vital Design.
- [Border Radius](/docs/design-tokens/radius): Corner radius tokens shared by inputs, buttons, cards, and dialogs.
- [Effects](/docs/design-tokens/effects): Elevation shadows, focus rings, button shadows, and gradient tokens.

## Registry

- [Registry](/docs/registry): Install Vital Design components individually using the shadcn CLI.

## Optional

- [Migration Guide v0 to v1](/docs/getting-started/migration-guide): Move from the legacy npm package surface to the registry-backed src-v2 components.
